tax.name: GST
tax.note: Prices exclude GST. 18% GST is added to each invoice; add a GSTIN in Billing to claim input tax credit.

strongAuth.title: Verify the payment with a one-time password
strongAuth.body: Your bank has sent a one-time password to the phone number linked to the card. Approve the {amount} payment to {company} to continue. No card details or codes are entered here.
strongAuth.rule: Additional factor of authentication (RBI) on every card payment. Recurring charges up to ₹15,000 under an e-mandate don't need it.

recurring.title: Set up an e-mandate for top-ups
recurring.body: You authorise {company} to charge up to {max} per top-up through a card e-mandate. You'll get a pre-debit notification at least 24 hours before each charge, and any charge above {max} asks for a one-time password. Cancel the mandate at any time in Top-ups.

autoRenewal.title: Your plan renews automatically
autoRenewal.body: {plan} renews every month on {date} at {price} plus 18% GST through your card e-mandate. We'll send a pre-debit notification 24 hours before each renewal. Cancel any time in Plan.
